measures.title: Issue 17 — Data center charter amendment

ballot_evidence.statement: Article IX, Section 9.06 "Prohibition of Construction of a Data Center"
ballot_evidence.source_title: Butler County Board of Elections — November ballot list

measures.legal_effect: Amends the city charter to prohibit construction of a data center. The precise power threshold and commencement date still need the full charter text.
